purpose: Forward Skyrim's original render-time jitter update, then set guarded engine dynamic-resolution ratios so the game's kMAIN world extent can be measured without claiming DLSS SR
replacement: encodeCallSiteReplacement to a verified near relay and pinned RazKolbas jitterProxy; original e58a10 called first; any ratio update gated by Diagnostics.ProbeReducedWorld, ManualRenderScale [0.5,1), exact BSGraphics::State pointer/layout, unclaimed lock, live kMAIN texture, and display-sized swap snapshot
abi: Renderer Begin at e44664 loads RCX=&BSGraphics::State RVA 328cc20, sets a byte, then CALLs e58a10. The original target prologue and the full 23-byte caller context must match. Return value is unused. Ratio floats are state +104/+108, previous floats +10c/+110, lock dword +118; width/height +24/+28.
activation: SKSEPlugin_Load only, before renderer/world threads; exact game file hash, decoded caller/target bytes, direct CALL and relay verified before write. Probe ratio remains disabled by default.
lifetime: DLL and relay pinned for process lifetime; no hot unpatch. Callback forwards original every time; display dimensions published from verified device-creation output.
recovery: Mismatch rejects before write. If the target or display extent changes while the probe owns its exact ratio/lock, the render-time callback restores ratio 1 and lock 0, then remains dormant. A foreign ratio or lock is never overwritten. Disable this patch ID or SafeMode on the next launch. UI/scissor compatibility is not yet established.
